notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market SaaS (customer support product) evaluating Redwood for chat-agent workloads. Primary ask: streaming + tool-calling integration (CRM + KB) with strict latency SLOs.

Requirements / context:
- Must support streaming responses and function/tool calls to internal CRM & ticketing.
- First-token SLO <1.5s median at 95th under typical peak patterns (target: 0.9-1.2s).
- 10 RPS steady-state from product; bursts to ~120 RPS during business hours; P95 tail sensitivity.
- Cost sensitive but willing to move to Dedicated reservation if Hosted meets SLOs at acceptable unit cost.
- Want routing: low-latency variants for UI, cheaper fallback for background summarization.
- Security: SSO (SAML), audit logs, customer-managed KMS optional, EU residency for EU-subset data.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "If we can't get <1.5s first token in streaming, we can't replace current edge service." — Head of Product (call 2/2).
- "Prefer Hosted for prototyping — Dedicated later for consistent throughput and cost predictability." — CTO (pricing call 3/10).

POC scope & success criteria:
- 2-week hosted streaming perf run (3/18 start): confirm median/95th first-token <1.5s at target load; verify tool-calling latency to internal CRM (<=200ms avg for call); validate fallback model routing under capacity constraints.
- Security sign-off: SOC2 inventory + DPA redline acceptance.

Open items / next actions:
- Redwood to share recommended batching/quantization settings and estimated Hosted unit cost at expected traffic profile (action: Rafael, 3/12).
- Legal to provide SOC2 letter + draft DPA (action: Redwood legal).
- Silverpine to provision sandbox credentials for tool-calling endpoints and share sample KB indices (action: Silverpine infra).

Notes style: shorthand, action items, and meeting refs. Expect choppy entries in subsequent updates.
short_summary: Mid-market support SaaS running POC for Hosted streaming + tool-calling. Key constraint: <1.5s first-token SLO; evaluating Dedicated if Hosted passes perf and pricing. Security (SOC2/DPA) in progress.
